note: SH579 — the declared exceptions to 'a red suite is a stop'. A suite that is red either blocks the next commit or has an entry here: dated, time-boxed, and pointing at the open task that removes it. Nothing else. cli/test/red-suites.test.mjs enforces the shape and kills an entry whose task has shipped or whose date has passed, so a forgotten exception goes red instead of quiet. Read docs/agents/build.md before adding one.

exceptions.test: replication — capture www.viglet.org, convert it into the instance, gate the replica
exceptions.why: The replication scenario dies at ops[28] with "'Page' does not declare a field named 'contentAfter'". SH693 shipped the writer and the generated template without the model, so `shio convert` emits a field no post-type declares and every conversion against a real instance is refused at the batch. It is one known defect with one known cause, filed as SH763 and diagnosed down to the two lines of cli/src/convert.mjs that write it — not an unexplained red. Safe to commit over because the failure is entirely in the conversion write path: nothing else in the suite reaches it, and the Java and JS gates are green, so a regression anywhere else still stops the build. It goes away with SH763 and this entry is deleted in that commit.
